description:
Get the most recent captured state of a Code Monitor page — the current extracted on-page fields (title, canonical, metaDescriptionContent, metaRobots, robotsTxt, sitemapXml, h1Heading, heading, statusCode, hreflang, imageOpenGraph, twitterImage, googleAnalytics, googleTagManager). Address the page with seoMonitorId (from list_code_monitor_pages) or url. Returns seo_monitor_id, url, captured_at (ISO, or null if never captured), and fields (the captured values; empty when no snapshot exists yet). Note: raw HTML and screenshots are not stored — only these structured fields. Returns not_found for an unknown page, missing_page_identifier when neither seoMonitorId nor url is given, feature_not_available when the plan lacks Code Monitor. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 3 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Latest captured on-page fields of the monitored pricing page.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","url":"https://example.com/pricing"}
```
name: get_code_monitor_snapshot
title: Page code snapshot
